description:
-= Studio =-
Guess what, you are in the place we're calling the studio. You try to gain information on your surroundings by using a technique you call "looking."



You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is unblocked. There is an unguarded exit to the north.
inventory: You are carrying: a Quote of the Day Calendar.
objective: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. Your first objective is to venture east. Then, recover the top hat from the workbench in the pantry. Got that? Good!
